div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 请求未到达 (连接断开)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 请求已到达 EcomPilot

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 已存在且 status='SUCCESS'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 不存在 (首次执行)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 正常返回 200 OK

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MySQL 已提交, 但响应中途断网超时!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status == 'SUCCESS'
(说明上次超时前 MySQL 其实已经退成功了!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status == 'NOT_FOUND'
(说明上次请求根本没落库)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 超过最大重试次数 (如 10 次) 仍失败

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: B 端主管点击批准 / 自动审批通过

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EcomOps 开启本地 PostgreSQL 事务:
1. 更新 claim_tickets 状态为 APPROVED_PENDING_CALLBACK
2. 插入 outbox_events 记录 (携带唯一键 refund_idempotency_key = 'REFUND_' + claim_no + '_V1')
3. 提交 PG 事务

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
调用 EcomPilot 内部接口:
POST /internal/v1/refunds/execute
Header/Body 携带 refund_idempotency_key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: EcomPilot (MySQL) 收到请求?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EcomOps 捕获 ConnectError / Timeout
保持 outbox 状态为 PENDING_RETRY

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EcomPilot 开启 MySQL 事务:
查询 refund_executions 表 WHERE idempotency_key = :key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 该 idempotency_key 是否已存在?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
直接返回已有执行结果 (200 OK, idempotent_replayed=True)
绝不重复退款!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. 插入 refund_executions (唯一索引 idempotency_key)
2. 按分摊规则更新 orders 状态为 REFUNDED_FULL / PARTIAL
3. 质量退货增加 defective_stock
4. 提交 MySQL 事务

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 响应返回给 EcomOps 时网络是否超时?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EcomOps 收到成功响应:
更新 PG claim_tickets 为 COMPLETED
更新 outbox_events 为 DONE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: EcomOps 后台 Outbox 对账协程 (每 30 秒扫描 PENDING_RETRY 记录)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
先调用 EcomPilot 对账查询接口:
GET /internal/v1/refunds/status?refund_idempotency_key=:key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 查询到的真实退款执行状态?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
更新 PG 状态为 CALLBACK_FAILED_MANUAL
触发运营告警台人工介入
